# Validator reports are the trust surface

On 2026-07-01 we chose to treat the validator's report as the single trust
surface for project knowledge, because the sample client spec requires that
contributors can rely on schema-checked artefacts. See the ingested source:
archive/documents/sample-client-spec/extracted/summary.md.
